info.title: Contrack API
info.description: The routes with a contract in shared/contracts/. `npm run api:openapi` writes this file from them, so change a contract rather than the file. docs/api-reference.md describes every route, how to authenticate and the error envelope.

get.summary: The authorization server metadata (RFC 8414)
The same metadata at the root path
The MCP endpoint's protected resource metadata (RFC 9728). 404 while OAuth is off
Every pending follow-up, soonest due first

patch.summary: Change a follow-up's title or due date
Mark a follow-up done. Done twice is still done

post.summary: Add the same follow-up to many contacts. One unknown id writes nothing

get.summary: The 50 follow-ups done most recently
How many pending follow-ups are due today or overdue
Every recurring background job with its last and next run, and the jobs that failed in the last 24 hours. Admin only

post.summary: Whether an invitation link can still make an account: 404 for one that never was, 410 for one used, revoked or expired

get.summary: A sign-in waiting for the person's answer, for the consent page

post.summary: Allow or deny a sign-in. Answers the address the browser goes to next

get.summary: The account's tokens, newest first, revoked and expired ones included

post.summary: Mint a token. The plaintext is in this answer and nowhere else

delete.summary: Stop a token working. Its row stays, for its owner to see

get.summary: Every contact in the network. `view=slim` answers the list view rows instead of whole contacts

post.summary: Add a contact

get.summary: One contact with every child record

put.summary: Change a contact. Each child array sent replaces the one stored

patch.summary: Change a contact's profile fields. A body with a child array is refused

delete.summary: Move a contact to the trash

get.summary: A contact's follow-ups, pending first

post.summary: Add a follow-up to a contact
Attach a file as the multipart field `attachment`, up to 50 MB. An .eml becomes an email interaction
Upload a photo as the multipart field `avatar`: JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP or AVIF, up to 10 MB
A short AI briefing on a contact, from its notes
Research one contact now and merge what it finds
Log an interaction. `actionItem` adds a follow-up in the same write

patch.summary: Place the pin by hand, or hand it back to the geocoder

post.summary: Make a ghost contact a full contact

get.summary: The contacts that share notes with this one, most shared first

post.summary: Not this person: take back what one research run added, and leave its pages out of later runs

get.summary: Why a tracked contact scores what it scores
A contact's timeline, newest first: its notes and the notes that mention it
The contacts due for contact: a follow-up date that has come, or a tracked contact past its cadence
The archived contacts, newest change first

post.summary: Import contacts. A known X-Import-Id answers 200 with the first run's counts and writes nothing. With Accept: text/event-stream the answer is a stream of progress events instead
Move contacts to the trash

put.summary: Change the same profile fields on many contacts

get.summary: The contacts with a pin, for the map

post.summary: Merge one contact into another
Merge up to ten contacts into one
Merge many clusters in one call, up to 250 merges in all
Undo a merge. By default the two contacts are also kept separate, so no scan or check merges them again

get.summary: Where a merged-away contact lives now, or null while the contact is live

post.summary: Put a pair that was kept separate back in the review, and let scans find it again

get.summary: Whether the server sends addresses to Nominatim (admin)

put.summary: Turn address lookups off or on for every account (admin)

get.summary: The contacts with an address and no pin, and why each has none
Every industry the contacts name, A to Z

patch.summary: Change an interaction's title or content

delete.summary: Delete an interaction and its attachment

get.summary: Search the notes. A date phrase in `q` is applied as a filter. Answers the hits alone
Every list, in the person's order

post.summary: Make a list. Its icon is a star unless the body names one

patch.summary: Rename a list or change its icon

delete.summary: Delete a list. Its contacts stay. A list that is already gone answers the same

get.summary: The contacts in a list, newest first

post.summary: Add a contact to a list

delete.summary: Take a contact out of a list

post.summary: Add many contacts to a list. `count` is how many were not in it

put.summary: Put the lists in a new order. Name each list exactly once

get.summary: Contacts as raw rows, newest first. Trashed, merged and ghost contacts are left out

get.summary: Every tag the contacts hold, A to Z

patch.summary: Rename a tag on every contact. Renaming onto a tag that exists merges the two

delete.summary: Remove a tag from every contact

get.summary: Every tag with the number of contacts that hold it
The whole timeline, newest first

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Entries on or after this date

ownerId.description: Internal. May be removed in a later version.

delete.summary: Delete every contact in the Trash forever, with their notes and files

get.summary: Start a sign-in. Answers 303 to the consent page, or to the client with an error

post.summary: Register a public client (RFC 7591). Unused, it goes after a day
Give a token back (RFC 7009). Its whole grant ends
Trade a code, or rotate a refresh token. A form body, as OAuth sends it
